name: mediation-brief-drafter
description: Use this skill when a litigator, in-house counsel, or ADR specialist needs to draft a two-part mediation brief for a civil mediation session under JAMS, AAA, FINRA, or court-annexed rules. Produces a DRAFT SHARED brief and a CONFIDENTIAL mediator-only brief with BATNA/WATNA/ZOPA analysis, settlement- authority worksheet, and a do-not-share audit for licensed counsel review.
